facts.fact: UNDP Togo says a digital assistant at the Direction nationale du contrôle de la commande publique helps staff search and analyse public procurement information, cutting a task from days to under a day.
UNDP Togo says a solution is being developed for the Ministry of Security to automate compliance checks of recruitment-competition applications.

facts.fact: UNDP Togo says a UNDP-donated GPU server, installed at Lomé Data Centre and run by Togo AI Lab, has been in service since July 2026 as Togo's first national AI computing capacity.

UNDP Togo says a UNDP-donated GPU server, installed at Lomé Data Centre and run by Togo AI Lab, has been in service since July 2026 and processed about 50,200 requests between 26 August and 27 October 2026.

TGO.note: Shared aspect not recorded: users are public bodies and Togo AI Lab members, but opening to outside users is not stated.
Lomé Data Centre hosts the server but the document does not say it rents to others.
No data protection law is stated.
Document does not say government staff build or run systems.
Ownership and for-hire status of Lomé Data Centre are not stated.
